title: End Mage's Aide
description: NO LONGER NEEDED SINCE ORIGINS++ V2.4 Fixes some Origins++ bugs from the End Mage origin
body:
# NO LONGER NEEDED SINCE ORIGINS++ V2.4
**The original mod's dev merged my pull request and the issue's fixed, if needed you can still use this on any older version though**

fixes the bugs listed in [this issue](https://github.com/QuantumXenon/origins-plus-plus/issues/508) on the origins++ github, listed as:

- Mana bugs not spawning at all
- Powers drain mana even when they fail to activate

pretty simple and easy fixes

**check out [Deathsworn's Aide](https://modrinth.com/datapack/deathsworn-aide) too!**
